reviewer.origin: Agent tool, a fresh context with only this brief and its files, launched by the Inner Child lane session (https://claude.ai/code/session_01NbUfhcTaRT8sbjyYV1wEFq), turn 115, 2026-10-26

evidence: Read “Do the same if you can’t stop yourself, and also when you’re badly disoriented or intoxicated, or can’t tell whether any of this is you. Getting safe first keeps the question of whether life is worth living open long enough to look at.” as a reader in crisis: every instruction and the order are intact, “A crisis line counts” is untouched, and “can’t tell” is still a trigger for “Do the same” (so it is treated as if it is you); “and also when” reads as an added case, not a required pair, and “any of this” (the page or the situation just described) leads to the same action either way. The question-knock-down and the “None of that is me answering… It just keeps…” shape are gone; “isn’t my answer” survives only as “keeps the question… open” (a step that keeps a question open does not answer it), which is a softer but true carrying of it. Linter: B4/E15 accepted, since the four triggers are his guide’s own list plus the grounding’s MUST, and splitting “can’t tell” out would bring back the knock-down; D9 is by design; E36/E41 is a safety instruction to the reader. T17 is PRESENT on the last sentence: it is the guide’s own point that the grounding says this paragraph must carry, said once in plain words with no flip, and it adds a consideration the paragraph lacks without it, so I accept it.
